item.title: Patti Edwards, wife of BYU coach LaVell Edwards, dead at 93
item.description: Patti Edwards, wife of hall of fame BYU football coach LaVell Edwards, passed away at the age of 93, the BYU athletics department announced Saturday.

item.title: Feds to move ahead with Colorado River plans after states don't reach deal
item.description: The U.S. Department of the Interior said it would be moving forward with its proposed plans to manage the Colorado River after the seven states failed to reach agreement on a framework of a deal.

item.title: Youth softball team spreads Valentine’s Day joy at Tooele homeless resource center
item.description: A local 12-U softball team delivered more than just supplies this Valentine's Day; they delivered joy to the residents of the Harris Community Village, a local crisis shelter.
